scorecard.rationale: The paper-filtered coffee crossover and fortified decaf post-nap crossover give favorable beverage-related acute fatigue contrasts. The pooled driving fatigue result was inconclusive and abrupt decaf replacement increased fatigue in a residential comparison. Several isolated-caffeine tasks after prescribed abstinence favored easing. The 2025 usual-diet cycling studies measured perceived fatigue separately and found no treatment effect with either tested dose. Exercise context, usual intake and participant ages differ from earlier mental-fatigue comparisons. The 2006 metabolic paper may share the older cycling cohort and supplies no fatigue result. The Parkinson caffeine trial interval spans both directions. The beverage comparisons still support minimal easing, with a controlled brewed-coffee Parkinson fatigue result unresolved.
